ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Money and Crisis" This course will examine how modern literary production, particularly the novel, has approached the topic of money in Europe and the Americas. We will approach texts from both thematic and formal standpoints, examining, for example, plots structured around monetary transactions and speculative ventures; we will also focus on the problems of representation inherent within both monetary and literary forms. Primary texts include works by Emile Zola, Frank Norris, Jorge Luis Borges and Juana Manuela Gorriti; secondary texts include works by Karl Marx, George Simmel, and Marc Shell, among others. Meets with CWL 441
